candidate: Local working tree based on d194dad8; application source hashed below; no deployment or push.
scope: Local backend, tests and evidence. Backup work remains deferred.
changes: Reuse the cost resolver role catalog for current and historical role names in point periods, including roles without a cost profile. No new cross-request cache.
Reuse the main detail Report rows for day/night hours in role consumption, avoiding the nested historical Report read from reportCollaborator. Parent and roster query filters/order retained.
httpMethod: Synthetic loopback HTTP against the real Express app and migrated PostgreSQL. Authentication validates persisted hashed sessions through requireAuth; password login is not exercised. First-process samples use a fresh API process per request, with warm database pages and process imports excluded. Warm requests mix surfaces, profiles and two sessions per profile under a bounded shared concurrency. Client timing includes response-body receipt; server timing includes authentication and serialization. Active-pool interval samples are observations, not individual query wait times. No Nginx, TLS, browser rendering, external API or production load is measured.

comparisonDesign.http: Two sequential equivalent synthetic cohorts with the summary consumer, same dependencies, CPU/memory/pool/concurrency and bounded fixture. Baseline application archived from d194dad8. No repeated randomized/paired timing comparison.
comparisonDesign.postgres: PostgreSQL 16; one CPU; 768 MiB; disposable loopback-only container.
comparisonDesign.sourceParity: Baseline and candidate execute in separate Node processes against exactly the same synthetic data. Entire outputs compared via assert.deepEqual after JSON normalization of Decimal values, Maps and Sets. Five surfaces checked in two phases, including writes to role name, salary and report hours.
comparisonDesign.sourceParityFixture: 120 historical RDOs plus three auxiliary reports and two extra RDOs, roster in both group members, planned role hours, day/night shifts, collaborator without point, role history/change and role without cost profile.
comparisonDesign.refreshTimeOrigin: After writes are acknowledged and sampling phase is prepared, not exact PostgreSQL commit timestamp. Cards retain cache expiry; immediate card freshness not asserted.

assertions: Exactly one JobRole SQL read for cost resolver plus current/history names.
Full calculation parity with original report-service source.
Historical role without cost profile, current role without profile, salary/model effective dates.
Next calculation reads renamed role; service/absence writes visible.
Complete member/group equality, monetary sums, source updates, category/division guards and point contracts.
Roster query omits nested Report selection and still returns exact day/night role hours.
No-session 401, wrong-module 403, module viewer 200, invalid projection 400.
Current/history/full, progress-only, group, division, viewer permissions, commercial sharing and worker source revision.

backendSuite.execution: Standalone complete backend suite; PostgreSQL opt-in regressions executed separately.

validation.frontend: No frontend files changed; frontend suite/build/budgets passed in d194dad8 stage and were not repeated here.
validation.ci: Existing labor parity and HTTP performance jobs already execute the strengthened PostgreSQL regressions; workflow unchanged.

limitations: No measured improvement in no-queue fraction: 26.3% baseline and 25.1% candidate. Peak waiting dropped 44 to 39 but longest observed waiting run increased 365.5 to 402.1 ms. Goal remains open.
Pool observations depend on event-loop sampling and do not measure individual query wait times. No observed waiting run over five seconds.
Only one cold API process sample per route/profile; cold p95 suppressed and general cold-reduction acceptance unproven.
No Nginx, TLS, browser, external API or production load measured; sequential p95 observations do not establish universal or causal improvement.
Response sizes unchanged; point summary still calculates financial allocations and performs 38 median database calls.
Reconciliation path does not execute changed calculations and was not benchmarked again in this round.
No grouped parent-report/roster query or changed source ordering; further per-member metadata work remains.
nextLocalWork: Share collaborator metadata between group members and measure source-query bursts and total HTTP waiting. Any concurrency control must report application wait instead of merely moving the pg pool queue.
